about.meta_desc: MAGHAREBIT POS is built by Wayloz Group, a Moroccan technology company, for merchants at home and in the diaspora.
about.hero_sub: MAGHAREBIT was born from a simple observation: Moroccan merchants deserved better software.
about.mission_p1: We build POS and retail management software specifically for the Moroccan market — with full Arabic RTL support, offline-first architecture, and pricing that works for small merchants and growing chains alike.
about.mission_p2: MAGHAREBIT is developed by Wayloz Group, a Moroccan technology company committed to building tools that serve merchants at home and in the diaspora.
about.val1_desc: Built by a Moroccan team, for Moroccan merchants.
about.val2_desc: Native RTL interface — not an afterthought, the foundation.
about.val3_desc: Your POS works even when the internet doesn't.
about.story1_text: A Moroccan developer notices that every POS on the market is either too expensive, too foreign, or doesn't support Arabic properly.
about.story2_text: MAGHAREBIT launches in Casablanca with 12 pilot merchants. Setup takes 2 minutes. The Arabic interface works.
about.story3_title: For merchants in Morocco and abroad
about.story3_text: MAGHAREBIT is built for merchants in Morocco and the diaspora: a simple POS in Arabic and French that keeps working without internet.

faq.meta_desc: All your questions about MAGHAREBIT POS: pricing, setup, support, contracts and comparisons.
faq.hero_sub: Clear answers to the questions Moroccan merchants ask most
faq.q1: Can I try MAGHAREBIT before buying?
faq.a1: Yes — request a free demo via the form or WhatsApp. A Moroccan expert will walk you through a live session.
faq.a2: Setup takes an average of 2 minutes. Our team helps you import your catalog and configure settings remotely.
faq.a3: Yes. MAGHAREBIT is offline-first — sales continue without a connection, data syncs automatically when back online.
faq.q4: Does it support barcodes and scales?
faq.a4: Yes — compatible with USB/Bluetooth barcode readers and connected scales — ideal for bakeries and supermarkets.
faq.a5: Subscription starts at 249 MAD/month for one store. Multi-branch plans available. No hidden fees.
faq.a6: No. Subscription is monthly and cancellable at any time with no penalties.
faq.q7: Can I pay in cash or by bank transfer?
faq.a7: Yes. We accept cash, bank transfer and card.
faq.a8: Yes. A Moroccan-format tax invoice is issued for every subscription, downloadable from the dashboard.
faq.q9: What is the difference between MAGHAREBIT and a Generic International POS?
faq.a9: A Generic International POS is built for a global market — no Darija, data abroad, no local support. MAGHAREBIT is built for the Moroccan merchant.
faq.q10: What is the difference from a traditional Windows POS?
faq.a10: A Windows POS needs manual maintenance. MAGHAREBIT is cloud with offline mode — automatic updates.
faq.q11: Does it work on all devices?
faq.a11: Yes. Compatible with Windows, Android and any modern browser. No specific terminal required.
faq.q12: How do I manage multiple branches?
faq.a12: One dashboard on your phone tracks all branches in real time — wherever you are.
faq.q13: What happens if I have a problem during business hours?
faq.a13: Support is available via WhatsApp and phone. Average response: under 2 hours.
faq.a14: Yes. Support available in Darija, Classical Arabic and French.
faq.q15: Do I need training to use MAGHAREBIT?
faq.a15: No. Most merchants start selling within 5 minutes. A Darija video guide is available.
faq.q16: Can I import data from another system?
faq.a16: Yes. Our team imports your catalog from Excel, CSV or another POS.
faq.a17: Your data is hosted on servers in Morocco, compliant with Law 09-08.
faq.a18: Yes. All data is AES-256 encrypted. We never share your data with third parties.
faq.q19: What happens to my data if I cancel?
faq.a19: Export all your data (CSV/Excel) before cancellation. We keep a backup for 30 days.
faq.q20: Is the system compliant with Moroccan invoicing regulations?
faq.a20: Yes. DGI-compliant invoices with ICE and IF fields. Ready for Moroccan tax requirements.
